articles.title_en: Czech crop invention heads to European farms through British partnership
articles.lead_en: A molecule developed in Olomouc could help cereal crops make better use of water and nutrients from their earliest stages of growth. Known as TFU, it is being brought to European farmers by British company INTRACROP under a licensing agreement with Palacký University.
